interpretation: The current source-equivalent model-call binding is suitable as a deterministic content identity but cannot alone distinguish two separate causal occurrences with byte-identical bound inputs/runtime/output. A separate occurrence identity can preserve replay idempotence while separating distinct executions and detecting same-event/different-content conflicts.
counterhypothesis: If every downstream NODE_RESULT/J-Space/evaluation consumer already binds an immutable enclosing execution-occurrence receipt carrying event/admission/route/plan/cell/attempt identity and enforces replay conflict semantics, the gap is already closed outside the model-call digest and the required delta is naming/contract clarification rather than a new authority.
